# Encounter Tables — Severed Lands

Roll 1d20 per travel segment or whenever the DM needs a complication. Tiers: Low (levels 1-4), Mid (5-10), High (11+). Region determines the table.

---

## Verdant Margin

### Low Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-2 | 2d4 Verdant Twigs (ambush from undergrowth) |
| 3-4 | 1d3 Riftwolves (hunting, may pass if party stays quiet) |
| 5-6 | 1 Verdant Vine (dangling across path, patient) |
| 7-8 | 1d4 Hollowlings (scavenging a recent kill, will flee if outnumbered) |
| 9-10 | 1 Riftstag (territorial, charges if approached) |
| 11-12 | Anchor Clearing (safe rest, supplies intact, no threat) |
| 13-14 | Rift pool (small, unattended, 1d4 Rift Leeches feeding at edge) |
| 15-16 | Verdant Scaled hunter (Reef or another, observing from canopy, may interact) |
| 17-18 | 1 Riftbear (feeding, distracted, can be avoided with stealth) |
| 19 | 1 Pack Hollowed (stalking prey, will test party's strength before committing) |
| 20 | Strange growth — a clearing of flowers that bloom violet in real time. Roll WIS save DC 12 or charmed toward the center where a Rift Treant waits. |

### Mid Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | 2d4 Pack Hollowed (coordinated ambush, surround tactics) |
| 4-5 | 1 Riftbear Mauler (territorial, near a Rift pool — regenerates) |
| 6-7 | 2 Riftwolf Hunters (phase-step flanking, targeting weakest party member) |
| 8-9 | 1 Verdant Mound (engulfing a recent kill, slow but area denial) |
| 10-11 | Rift pool (large, 2d4 Rift Leeches, 1 Rift Ooze at center) |
| 12-13 | 1d4+1 Verdant Blights (drawn to recent bloodshed) |
| 14-15 | Verdant Scaled hunting party (3-5 hunters, neutral, may demand party leave territory) |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Owlbear (nesting, guarding cubs, will pursue if cubs threatened) |
| 18 | 1 Rift Hydra (young, 3 heads, lairing in a large Rift pool) |
| 19 | Anchor Door fragment — active, humming, attracting riftbeasts. 2d4 Riftwolves circling. |
| 20 | Elder Riftbeast sighting — massive shape moving through canopy. It hasn't noticed the party. Yet. |

## The Hollows

### Low Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | 1d6 Hollowlings (scurrying through debris, will trade for food) |
| 4-5 | 1 Rift Crawler (on ceiling, waits for isolated target) |
| 6-7 | 1 Rift Darkmantle (drops from above, darkness sphere fills corridor) |
| 8-9 | Phasing event — the street breathes. DEX save DC 12 or separated from party. |
| 10-11 | 1d4 Rift Skeletons (replaying a death, don't notice living unless touched) |
| 12-13 | Scavenger — Roll 1d4: 1=Rigg, 2=Compact member, 3=Hollows Crew, 4=desperate newcomer. |
| 14-15 | 1 Rift Shadow (clinging to a wall, feeds on warmth) |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Piercer (drops from vaulted ceiling, single strike then retreats) |
| 18 | 1 Rift Mimic (disguised as a promising Warden fragment cache) |
| 19 | Hollowed Speaker — fragments of prophecy, 50% useful, 50% nonsense. |
| 20 | The Breathing Street phases back. Something is different about it this time. |

### Mid Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | 2d4 Rift Ghouls (drawn to recent death, will feed on fallen) |
| 4-5 | 1 Rift Ghost (reliving final moments, may possess a party member) |
| 6-7 | 1 Veil Gazer (watches from shadows, offers forbidden knowledge for a price) |
| 8-9 | 1 Anchor Sentinel (reactivates when party enters Warden-marked area) |
| 10-11 | 1 Veil Pilgrim (shambles toward nearest Rift pool, ground warps around it) |
| 12-13 | Hollows Crew — Roll 1d4: 1=Kell's Iron (professional), 2=Breathless (reckless), 3=Glimmer Boys (territorial), 4=new crew (unpredictable) |
| 14-15 | 1 Rift Umber Hulk (confused, lashing out, confusion gaze) |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Wraith (consumed by hatred, drains life on touch) |
| 18 | Deep Hollowed — a Cavern Hollowed or Deep Hollowed, may speak in fragments, may attack. |
| 19 | Sealed Warden chamber — door intact, sigils active, something inside is awake. |
| 20 | The Pit — an offering circle at the edge. Something is watching from below. |

| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | 1d4 Riftwolves (pack hunting, test the party's formation) |
| 4-5 | 1 Rift Dust or Rift Smoke (swirling ahead, visibility reduced) |
| 6-7 | 1 Rift Skeleton (replaying a death near a Door fragment) |
| 8-9 | Rift pool (small, 1d4 Rift Leeches, faint humming) |
| 10-11 | Prospector — Joss or another independent, may share route info for coin |
| 12-13 | 1 Rift Cinder (curious, follows at distance) |
| 14-15 | Rift Raider scouts — 1d3 Rift Raiders on Pteranodon-back, observing from above |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Phase Spider (ambush from a pillar crevice) |
| 18 | Rift Seeker — Iro or another, offers cryptic warning, won't elaborate |
| 19 | 1 Rift Bulette (erupts from ground, drawn by movement vibrations) |
| 20 | Door fragment — active, humming, partially buried. Excavation will take hours. |

### Mid Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | 1 Rift Ankheg (bursts from ground beneath a party member) |
| 4-5 | 2d4 Rift Raiders (raiding party, ground-based, will demand tribute or fight) |
| 6-7 | 1 Rift Gorgon (metal-plated, petrifying breath, wandering between pillars) |
| 8-9 | Rift pool (large, 1 Rift Jelly, 2d4 Rift Leeches, regeneration zone for anything wounded nearby) |
| 10-11 | 1 Rift Displacer (phase-shifted, tentacles strike from unexpected angles) |
| 12-13 | 1 Rift Behir (coiled around a pillar, lightning-Rift breath) |
| 14-15 | Rift Raider warband — Roll 1d4: 1=Ashen Claw (Korr), 2=Silent Wing (Vex, aerial), 3=Broken Spear (desperate), 4=mixed patrol |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Roc (circling overhead, shadow darkens the ground, hasn't dived yet) |
| 18 | Old Crane's Spire — the signal tower is flashing. Crane has information. It's bad news. |
| 19 | Door Graveyard — the circle of dead Doors. Safe to rest. Something has left recent tracks here. |
| 20 | Elder Riftbeast — it's awake. The ground trembles. Everyone in the Cairnfields knows. |

## Thornwall Trade Routes

### Low Tier (1d20)
| Roll | Encounter |
|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | Caravan Jackals — Roll 1d4: 1=Red Banner (Gareth, professional), 2=Dusk Boys (Shrike, night raid), 3=Tollmen (bridge toll), 4=Cairn Rats (desperate) |
| 4-5 | Wrecked caravan — looted, no bodies, riftbeast tracks leading away |
| 6-7 | Guild caravan — Orin Thatch or another caravaneer, may need escort or share route news |
| 8-9 | Heavy weather — Rift-charged storm, lightning strikes nearby, visibility zero |
| 10-11 | 1d4 Riftwolves (following, testing, will attack if party shows weakness) |
| 12-13 | Thornwall guard patrol — checking registrations, suspicious of Riftborn |
| 14-15 | Returner patrol — Stern or another, may share intelligence about route ahead |
| 16-17 | 1 Rift Leech swarm — 2d6 individuals, drawn by body heat |
| 18 | Merchant in distress — wagon broken, guards fled, offering payment for escort |
| 19 | Rift pool (small, new — wasn't here last week, already attracting attention) |
| 20 | Strange traveler — identity varies: Echo the bard, The Silent, a Hollowed prophet. Always knows something useful. |

---

## Using These Tables

- **Roll when:** Party travels between locations, camps in wild territory, or the session needs a complication.
- **Reskin freely:** A "Riftwolf" encounter in the Margin becomes a "Rift Raider scout" encounter in the Cairnfields with the same stat block. The narrative wrapper changes; the mechanics stay consistent.
- **Stack complications:** If a roll seems too easy, add a second factor — the Riftwolf pack is near a Rift pool (regeneration), or the Raiders have a Rift Pteranodon providing aerial support.
- **The 20s are for when you want the session to pivot.**
